verdict.rationale: Aider's docs show it can edit files, commit changes, run tests/lint, and be scripted with a single instruction, but there is no evidence of native GitHub/issue-tracker integration, automatic branch creation, or PR opening/pushing — the core of 'tracked issue to PR end-to-end.' Community mentions (e.g., Dosu integration) are third-party wrappers, not Aider itself performing this workflow.
